metadata.title: My First Week at Humanitarians AI.
metadata.audience: Students and new volunteers curious what humanitarian AI work looks like up close
metadata.greeting_note: hello lexicon: Spanish (short form; HAI word budget). Namaste used by the previous reel.
metadata.note: ai-explainer, Plain register, claude-hai channel (kicker 'Irreducibly Human', chip @HumanitariansAI on every Claude page + outro). Source = the author's brief ONLY: HAI works with Homes of Hope educating young orphan girls from India; helping them learn English as a second language for studies and future job search; HAI uses AI models to create virtual learning content. Nothing else about either organisation is claimed; process lines are framed as the author's understanding. No statistics. No photographs of real children (privacy + REBUILD LAW). Never publishes.

skin_warnings: B09: palette=claude but the outro is 'HandleTitleOutro' — OUTRO LAW wants ClaudeTitleOutro

beats.role_note: COLD OPEN LAW — Claude UI first; the ask lands answered with the three lessons.
beats.narration_text: Hola. After my first week at Humanitarians A I, I asked Claude to help me sort out what I actually learned. It came back with three things, and all three start with people.

show.event: composer on cream; greeting 'Hola, Shubh'
the ask types in
three result lines land: partnership · English · AI-made lessons

props.command: What did I actually learn in my first week at Humanitarians AI?
output: 1 · a partnership with Homes of Hope
2 · English as a second language, for school and work
3 · AI-made lessons, with people at the center

beats.role_note: EXECUTIVE-SUMMARY LAW — hesitant writer. Misconception corrected: humanitarian AI starts with TECHNOLOGY / English is a SUBJECT → starts with the PEOPLE / English is a DOOR (single-word triggers: the component matches one token). Opens 'Hi, I'm Shubh… this video is about…' per the brief.
beats.narration_text: Hi, I'm Shubh, and this video is about my first week at Humanitarians A I: how we work with Homes of Hope to help young girls in India learn English, and how A I helps build their lessons. It starts with people, not technology.

show.event: types 'Humanitarian AI starts with the technology.'
'technology' turns terracotta, backspaces, becomes 'people'
types 'English is a subject.'
'subject' becomes 'door'

props.text:
Humanitarian AI starts with
the technology.
English is a subject.

beats.role_note: FRAMEWORK — the partnership. Roles on the cards are the brief's own words, nothing added.
beats.narration_text: First: the partnership. Humanitarians A I works with Homes of Hope to educate young orphan girls in India. Two teams, one goal: a strong education that the girls can build their futures on.

show.event: 'Humanitarians AI' card lands
'Homes of Hope' card lands
both join into the shared-goal card; terracotta dot at the meeting point

props.goal: A strong education for young girls in India

beats.role_note: WORKED EXAMPLE — one language opens two doors (studies now, job search later).
beats.narration_text: Second: why English. For these girls, English is a second language. Getting stronger in it opens two doors: doing better in their studies now, and standing out in job searches later.

show.event: 'SECOND LANGUAGE — English' card
'Studies — doing better in class now' branches out
'Job search — standing out later' branches out
bottom line: 'Stronger English, more open doors.'

beats.role_note: ASK→RESULT micro-beat (mid-reel Claude page, chip @HumanitariansAI). An example request; output lines name what was asked for, not results.
beats.narration_text: Third: the tools. Humanitarians A I uses A I models to create virtual learning content. A request like this one is where a lesson begins.

show.event: composer with an example lesson request, already typed
three lines: script · narration and visuals · practice questions

props.command: Turn a short lesson on everyday English phrases into a friendly video: simple words, clear narration, pictures, and three practice questions.

beats.role_note: RESULT of B04 — the lesson loop as the author understands it (framed so in narration).
beats.narration_text: Here's the loop as I understand it. A lesson idea goes in. A I helps draft the script, the narration and the visuals. A person reviews it. The girls learn and practice, and what they need shapes the next lesson.

show.event: stages light in spoken order: Idea → AI drafts → Review → Learn → Feedback
chips 'script · narration · visuals · practice' under 'AI helps draft'
centre line 'Each lesson shapes the next.'; terracotta dot keeps looping

beats.role_note: FALSIFIABILITY / when NOT to — AI speeds the content, it cannot supply the care. Side-by-side, held.
beats.narration_text: The biggest thing I learned this week: A I can help make lessons faster, but it can't replace care. The technology scales the content. People make it matter.

show.event: 'AI helps with' column fills
'People bring' column fills
verdict 'AI scales the content. People make it matter.' + terracotta rule

props.verdict: AI scales the content. People make it matter.

beats.role_note: Verdict artifact page (Claude UI is the subject). Chip @HumanitariansAI via brandLabel.
beats.narration_text: Let's recap with Claude. A partnership with Homes of Hope. English as a door to studies and work. A I that helps build the lessons. And people at the center of all of it.

show.event: artifact card opens
four lines stagger in, in spoken order

props.artifactTitle: My First Week at Humanitarians AI — one page
artifactLines: Partnership: Humanitarians AI works with Homes of Hope to educate young girls in India.
Why English: a second language that opens doors to studies and jobs.
How: AI models help create virtual learning content.
The center: technology scales the content; people make it matter.

beats.role_note: HANDOFF LAW — prompt read aloud verbatim, then discussed.
beats.narration_text: Your turn. Paste this into Claude: I want to help someone learn English as a second language. Suggest one short, friendly lesson I could make with A I, and tell me what a person should check before a learner sees it. That last part is the point. Try it.

show.event: greeting 'Your turn.'; the prompt types into the composer
runningText 'paste this into Claude…'

beats.narration_text: My first week at Humanitarians A I. Thanks for watching. At Humanitarians A I.
